title: International Observe the Moon Night 2026
description: Join SEDS Sri Lanka and SEDS India for an interactive virtual celebration of International Observe the Moon Night 2026. Experience live high-definition lunar telescopic streaming provided by SEDS Celestia, guided scientific sessions, and interactive discussions.
shortDescription: Annual global celebration of lunar science and exploration with SEDS Sri Lanka in collaboration with SEDS India, featuring live lunar telescope streaming powered by SEDS Celestia.

agenda.title: Inauguration & Joint Collaboration Briefing
agenda.description: Welcome address by SEDS Sri Lanka & SEDS India leadership, live broadcast introduction, and telescope imaging overview powered by SEDS Celestia.

agenda.title: Lunar Maria Keynote: Northern & Eastern Basaltic Seas (7 Maria)
agenda.description: Scientific keynote on lunar basalt maria formation covering Day 1 features: Mare Frigoris, Mare Imbrium, Mare Nubium, Mare Serenitatis, Mare Tranquillitatis, Mare Fecunditatis, and Mare Crisium.

agenda.title: Telescopic Target 01: Plato Crater & Mare Frigoris / Mare Imbrium
agenda.description: Live high-magnification telescope stream kicks off! High-resolution observation of Plato Crater (Impact Crater #01) with its dark basaltic lava-filled floor situated between Mare Frigoris and Mare Imbrium.

agenda.title: Telescopic Target 03: Apennine Mountains (Montes Apenninus)
agenda.description: Guided telescopic exploration of the towering Apennine Mountains (Montes Apenninus, Mountain Range #03) rising over 5,000 meters along the lunar terminator bordering Mare Imbrium and Mare Serenitatis.

agenda.title: Telescopic Target 05 & Apollo Sites: Alphonsus Crater, Apollo 11 & Apollo 12
agenda.description: Close-up inspection of Alphonsus Crater (Complex Crater #05 with dark pyroclastic volcanic vents), along with historic Apollo landing sites: Apollo 11 at Mare Tranquillitatis and Apollo 12 at Oceanus Procellarum.

agenda.title: Live Moon Trivia Quiz, Q&A & Day 1 Wrap-Up
agenda.description: Interactive live lunar astronomy trivia quiz, Q&A with telescope operators and astrophysicists, Day 2 preview, and digital certificate announcements before concluding at 11:00 PM.
